title: Spark-Ledger Tender
text: Spark-Ledger Tender marks every charged device as reactor property and begins disassembly before the ink dries. On loss, suffer 1 Wound.
flavor: Its inventory has only one destination.

defeatReward.text: Spark-Ledger Tender is defeated and its identifying marks are entered into your Trophy Pile.
